QuestInfo.name: Protect Nero!
QuestInfo.0: I should check #p2012018# out at Orbis Park.
QuestInfo.1: #p2012018# was furious about the monsters near Orbis tormenting Nero. He wants you to teach them a lesson!
QuestInfo.2: Ericsson was livid towards the fact that the monsters outside Orbis had been making his cat Nero's life miserable, so with his blessing, I proceeded to teach those monsters a lesson or two.

0.0: It's been a while. How has your journey been since then? I have been feeling less than stellar these days because of the mean monsters wandering right outside Orbis. My Nero has been living in fear lately because he's been attacked by those monsters quite often these days. Darn those monsters!
0.1: I can't just leave it like this, or Nero will be wounded from head to toe one of these days. Can you please help me out? I'll reward you well for your work.

yes.0: Nero is in danger as long as those mean old monsters are strutting around! There's a whole lot of #b#o3210200#, #o3210201#, and #o3210202##k monsters just creeping all over here! Please take out #b30 of each#k to make this place kitty-safe!

no.0: Can you do it for Nero's sake? Look at him, he's wounded. Don't you think Nero needs help?

1.0: Hey, you're back! Thanks to you, it seems like the number of monsters have decreased dramatically these days. Nero is healing faster than I thought, all thanks to you. He should be out roaming around in no time. I'm so glad everything turned out alright.

yes.0: Do you like the scroll that I gave you? It's perfect for the ones that raise pets. If you also happen to have an adorable pet like Nero, try using that scroll on it.

item.0: That's not enough. Nero is still trembling in fear. Please take out 30 #b#o3210200#, #o3210201#, and #o3210202##k monsters!

mob.0: That's not enough. Nero is still trembling in fear. Please take out 30 #b#o3210200#, #o3210201#, and #o3210202##k monsters!
